description: Photovoltaic panels installed in the domestic sector per 1000 residents is a dataset listed in Malta Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by National Statistics Office. Total photovoltaic panels installed in the domestic sector per 1,000 residents in each locality up till 2014. Coverage: National Statistics Office. The publisher named on the listing is National Statistics Office. Its keywords include Energy. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2025-11-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-mt.
